author: komonews
title: Armed man threatens others and himself on Lake City Way before surrendering
text:
A man was taken into custody Wednesday night after a standoff involving a firearm on Lake City Way, police said.
Hail and rain are coming down across the region as a winter storm warning is in effect for the Cascade mountains.A man was taken into custody Wednesday night after a standoff involving a firearm on Lake City Way, police said.
Officers responded around 7:20 p.m. to reports of a man who had stopped his vehicle in the northbound lanes just south of Northeast 80th Street.No shots were fired, according to Seattle police.
